catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.subtitle: All the option lists in the system: statuses, grades, brands, capacities… Add, rename, reorder or deactivate values without touching code.
catalogs.no_items: This catalog has no values yet
catalogs.delete_item_msg: If any unit already uses it, it cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
catalogs.delete_msg: It will be deleted along with all its values.
catalogs.key_hint: Internal identifier; lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. It cannot be changed later.
catalogs.sellable: Units with this grade can be sold
catalogs.not_sellable_hint: When testing finishes with this grade, the unit becomes “Not sellable” and cannot be reserved.
catalogs.parent_hint: E.g. models depend on brands, so each model is assigned to its brand.
catalogs.parent_locked: Cannot be changed: values are already assigned to a value of the parent catalog.
catalogs.parent_item_hint: Which one this value belongs to (optional).

equipment.title: Equipment types & attributes
equipment.subtitle: Define what data each equipment type carries. The lot and testing forms build themselves from this configuration.
equipment.legend: ▤ = asked when registering the lot · * = required to finish testing
equipment.serial_required: Each unit must have a serial number
equipment.delete_type_msg: It can only be deleted if nothing uses it. If lots or units of this type exist, deactivate it.
equipment.attributes_hint: Choose what data it carries and when: on the lot line (purchase), required when registering the lot, or required to finish testing.
equipment.datatype_locked: The data type cannot be changed because data may already be stored.
equipment.enable_multiple_hint: Can this equipment have the same component more than once (e.g. two hard drives)? You can allow choosing several values for this attribute without losing what's already stored.
equipment.enable_multiple_title: Allow several values for this attribute?
equipment.enable_multiple_confirm: From now on you'll be able to pick more than one value in "{{name}}". Nothing already stored is lost. This change can't be undone.
equipment.enable_multiple_done: Done: you can now pick several values for this attribute.
equipment.type_list_hint: The values that can be chosen in this field for this equipment type (e.g. laptop models).
equipment.suggest_hint: When filling this field the values of this catalog are offered (filtered by the chosen brand); you can still type another one.
